programImageUrl.description: Normalize program cover-image URLs: DAM paths (start /P or /A — group 1423 carries both program-path and product-path images, confirmed on the 2026-08-20 first load) get the DAM host + asset-space prefix; site-relative paths (/coverimage..., /bigcovers...) get the images.pearson.com host; everything else (absolute URLs, Oracle TBD/N-A sentinels) passes through unchanged. Same trigger set as gold_product.product's pearsonImageUrl.

columns.businessDescription: Oracle internal surrogate. Part of the natural key.
columns.notes: ORGANIZATION_ID = 82 arrived in the template's Transform column, but it is a row FILTER - recorded structurally here instead. It is really an ENTITY-scope filter (which rows are programs): the intake contract has no entity-level filter field yet, and gold_product.product carries its equivalent (SEGMENT1 LIKE 'A%') in the manifest sot_filter. Resolve when the manifest is generated.
The template's Transform column held "like 'P2%'" - a row filter, not a transform, so it is recorded structurally. Entity-scope, same caveat as organizationId.
Translations table is (item, org)-grained, so it joins on the FULL entity key - mirroring gold_product.product.longDescription. Filter whitespace normalized from the template's LANGUAGE='US'.

URL normalization via the programImageUrl rule (mapping owner, 2026-08-10): the same shape as gold_product.product's pearsonImageUrl but triggering on the /P DAM prefix instead of /A. Pass-through keeps absolute URLs and the Oracle TBD/N-A sentinels as-is, matching product's keep-source-data rule. CONFIRMED by the mapping owner 2026-08-11: /P is the correct DAM prefix for program images, and the DAM asset space is the SAME as product's, so the inherited host + GUID is right. The /coverimage% and /bigcovers% site-relative branches are retained on the owner's expectation that those shapes may occur here too - they are inherited from product and not yet observed in ATTR_GROUP_ID 1423, but an unmatched branch is inert, so keeping them costs nothing and dropping them could lose real values. Worth confirming against the first load.

source.filter: ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1421 link, then the per-catalog parent test — see notes

derivation.sql:
WITH parent_named AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT C_EXT_ATTR9 AS parent_ppid
  FROM items_ext
  WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1401
    AND C_EXT_ATTR9 IS NOT NULL
),
parent_self AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(a1164.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
                  CAST(a1164.ORGANIZATION_ID  AS BIGINT) AS oid
  FROM items_ext a1164
  JOIN items_ext a741
    ON a741.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 741
   AND CAST(a741.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = CAST(a1164.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)
  WHERE a1164.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1164
    AND a1164.C_EXT_ATTR2 IS NOT NULL
    AND a1164.C_EXT_ATTR2 = a741.C_EXT_ATTR8
)
SELECT link.C_EXT_ATTR1     AS program_ppid,
       min(prod.SEGMENT1)   AS parentProduct
FROM items_ext link
JOIN items_all prod
  ON CAST(prod.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = CAST(link.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)
 AND CAST(prod.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)   = 82
LEFT JOIN parent_named pn
  ON pn.parent_ppid = prod.SEGMENT1
LEFT JOIN parent_self ps
  ON ps.iid = CAST(prod.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)
 AND ps.oid = CAST(prod.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)
WHERE link.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1421
  AND link.C_EXT_ATTR1 IS NOT NULL
  AND ((prod.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID =  10002 AND pn.parent_ppid IS NOT NULL)
    OR (prod.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID <> 10002 AND ps.iid IS NOT NULL))
GROUP BY 1

columns.notes: DERIVED — carries its own query (derivation.sql, ADR-0008: the query is the contract); a change to it is an engineer's plan while the shipped SQL keeps its pre-wrap shape. Three hops: program --(EAV group 1421, linked on the program's ppid as a STRING)--> its associated products --> the one that qualifies as parent. The test differs by catalog group. DIGITAL (ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = 10002): the product is the parent because a SIBLING names it, i.e. some group-1401 row carries this product's ppid in C_EXT_ATTR9 (parentPPID); the 1401 row sits on the child, so it is an existence test against other items. NON-DIGITAL: the product is the top of its own tree, i.e. its own group-1164 C_EXT_ATTR2 (ParentISBN13) equals its own group-741 C_EXT_ATTR8 (ISBN13) — self-referential and item-local. Where more than one product qualifies, min(SEGMENT1) is taken: a deterministic pick is required because an unordered 'first' would move the canonical hash between identical runs and ping every consumer forever (A8). Source query confirmed correct by the mapping owner 2026-08-12.

columns.joinKey: EGO_MTL_SY_ITEMS_EXT_B.C_EXT_ATTR1 = program.SEGMENT1 (ATTR_GROUP_ID 1421) -> MTL_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID at ORGANIZATION_ID = 82 -> SEGMENT1

derivation.sql:
SELECT link.C_EXT_ATTR1                          AS program_ppid,
       array_sort(collect_list(prod.SEGMENT1))    AS associatedProducts
FROM items_ext link
JOIN items_all prod
  ON CAST(prod.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = CAST(link.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)
 AND CAST(prod.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)   = 82
WHERE link.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1421
  AND link.C_EXT_ATTR1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

columns.notes: Value array (one string per associated product), sorted by the value itself - the shape gold_product.product.webConsumingSystem/programPpid use. TWO-HOP: rows come from the EAV group 1421 link, then resolve to the associated product's SEGMENT1. Template's verbatim source SQL: select product.segment1 from mtl_system_items_b main JOIN EGO_MTL_SY_ITEMS_EXT_B pf ON pf.C_EXT_ATTR1 = main.segment1 AND pf.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1421 JOIN mtl_system_items_b product ON pf.inventory_item_id = product.inventory_item_id AND product.organization_id = 82.

columns.joinKey: MTL_RELATED_ITEMS.(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, ORGANIZATION_ID) = program entity key -> RELATED_ITEM_ID -> MTL_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B.SEGMENT1; RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID -> FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL.LOOKUP_CODE (LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MTL_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES')
columns.filter: ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID IN (1001, 13001) AND INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('ERROR', 'DELETE')

derivation.sql:
WITH rel_type_map AS (
  SELECT LOOKUP_CODE     AS code,
         max(MEANING)    AS relationshipType
  FROM rel_types
  WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MTL_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES'
    AND ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CAST(r.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
       CAST(r.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)   AS oid,
       transform(
         array_sort(collect_list(named_struct(
           's1', rp.SEGMENT1,
           's2', lk.relationshipType,
           'p', named_struct(
             'programPpid',      rp.SEGMENT1,
             'relationshipType', lk.relationshipType
           )))),
         x -> x.p) AS relatedPrograms
FROM related r
JOIN items_all pgm
  ON CAST(pgm.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = CAST(r.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)
 AND CAST(pgm.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)   = CAST(r.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)
 AND pgm.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID IN (1001, 13001)
 AND pgm.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('ERROR', 'DELETE')
JOIN items_all rp
  ON CAST(rp.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = CAST(r.RELATED_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)
 AND CAST(rp.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)   = CAST(r.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)
 AND rp.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID IN (1001, 13001)
 AND rp.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('ERROR', 'DELETE')
 AND rp.SEGMENT1 LIKE 'P2%'
LEFT JOIN rel_type_map lk
  ON CAST(CAST(r.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID AS BIGINT) AS STRING) = lk.code
GROUP BY 1, 2

columns.notes: Struct array (related program + relationship type), sorted by programPpid - the shape gold_product.product.contributors uses. Sources MTL_RELATED_ITEMS and FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL are both present in uif_echo_dev_silver_mdm (both carry _silver_updated_at), so there is no Bronze->Silver prerequisite. ALIASING: programPpid reads MTL_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B for the RELATED item, not the program's own row - the SQL needs a SECOND alias over the driving table, because Phase 2 replaces the driving alias's temp view. TYPES: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID is numeric and LOOKUP_CODE is a string, so the join needs an explicit CAST; confirm the _VL language view returns one row per code after the LOOKUP_TYPE/ENABLED_FLAG predicates. CDC: FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL has no entity-key column, so its key_mapping is the constant org fan-out organizationId = 82 (product's org_params pattern). STABILITY: if one program relates to the same program under two relationship types, programPpid alone ties - add relationshipType as a sort tie-breaker (ADR-0003 array_sort_keys).
